_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.51.0 for group without keys, JSON functions, nulls order and more SQL to Pine; beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.69.0 for sign-in, usage stats, per-connection policies and agent proposals. beamlynx-ui 0.69.0 needs pine-lang 0.51 (its RequiredVersion).
